  4. Round 27root cause found: the sensor is band-limited near 50 Hzscored

    ■fail

    2026-08-14 11:06 UTC

    796 Hz of samples carrying 50 Hz of content — the strike-vs-ring difference is filtered out before it reaches us

    biggest gapPower above 100 Hz is 9-10 orders down, at numerical noise. A knuckle strike is broadband to several kHz; none of it arrives. This explains all eleven failed mechanisms, and why rise time measured 13.8 vs 12.6 ms (that was the filter, not the taps). The service exposes ReportInterval and BatchInterval only - 27 of 29 candidate bandwidth/filter/ODR keys return nothing, so the ceiling is not ours to move.

    tunk-score 0.1.0 · detector TunkCore.TapDetector · split test

  5. Round 26lap: ten mechanisms, none reach the barscored

    ■fail

    2026-08-14 11:06 UTC

    Unlimited latency does not close lap — the window saturates at 280 ms and 77.5 %

    biggest gapOn a lap the second strike and the first strike's ring are the same size in the envelope, so hearing the second tap also hears the tail's ripple, the group becomes 3 onsets, and the grouper fires on exactly 2. Curing deafness (12 -> 2 on lap) recovered zero gestures. The only remaining candidate is a front end that separates strike from ring, which is research. Held-out still has no typing or confound sessions.

  6. Round 25diagnosis corrected: deafness, not weaknessscored

    ■fail

    2026-08-14 09:56 UTC

    The second taps are 1.2-2.0x the bar. The detector was disarmed when they landed.

    biggest gapRe-arm needs the envelope back under 0.4x threshold; a damped case rings for hundreds of ms, so the detector is deaf through the second strike. Every soft miss and half the lap misses are this. Four amplitude mechanisms were built on the wrong premise and rejected. Held-out also has no typing or confound sessions, so the make-or-break metric is ungraded out of sample.
